title: Pantry Inventory
emptyPantryDesc: Start by adding items manually or use AI receipt scanner.
aiScanDesc: Upload or take a photo of your receipt to auto-extract items.
deleteModalMessage: Are you sure you want to remove {{name}} from your pantry?

categoryDescriptions.dairy: Milk, cheese, butter, eggs, and dairy products.
categoryDescriptions.produce: Fresh and frozen fruits and vegetables.
categoryDescriptions.meat: Chicken, turkey, and other poultry and meat products.
categoryDescriptions.bakery: Fresh bread, cakes, pastries and baked goods.
categoryDescriptions.beverages: Juices, soft drinks, water and hot beverages.
categoryDescriptions.pantryStaples: Essential staples and dry goods including rice and pasta.
categoryDescriptions.snacks: Chips, nuts, chocolates, sweets and snacks.
categoryDescriptions.frozen: Frozen meals, vegetables and ready-to-cook items.
categoryDescriptions.household: Cleaning supplies, detergents and home essentials.
categoryDescriptions.sauces: Sauces, ketchup, mayonnaise, vinegar, and condiments.
categoryDescriptions.spices: Spices, herbs, and seasonings used in cooking.
categoryDescriptions.canned: Canned foods, preserved foods, and pickles.
categoryDescriptions.pasta: Pasta, noodles, macaroni, and related products.
categoryDescriptions.legumes: Beans, lentils, chickpeas, and other legumes.
categoryDescriptions.oils: Cooking oils, butter, ghee, and other fats.
categoryDescriptions.personalCare: Personal care items, shampoos, soaps, and cosmetics.
categoryDescriptions.breakfast: Breakfast cereals, jams, honey, and other breakfast items.
categoryDescriptions.other: Other items not listed in the categories above.

cameraPermission: Camera access is required to take photos.
